enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed in Bedroom 1. Pull the blanket over the body. Close the eyes. Turn onto the right side. Adjust the pillow with the hand. Stay still. Turn onto the left side. Pull the blanket up. Breathe steadily. Turn onto the back. Extend the right arm. Withdraw the right arm. Roll onto the right side. Pull the blanket down slightly. Turn the head to the other side. Remain motionless. Turn onto the left side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Stay lying down. Open the eyes at 06:30. Sit up on the edge of the bed.

Stand up from the bed. Walk from Bedroom 1 to the Bathroom. Turn on the Bathroom light. Press the WaterHeater switch on. Turn on the tap. Rinse both hands under the water. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth with water. Put the toothbrush down. Turn off the tap. Turn on the shower tap. Step under the water. Wash the face and body with both hands. Turn off the shower tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face, arms and body. Hang the towel back on the hook. Pick up the clothes. Put on the shirt. Put on the trousers. Put on the socks. Turn off the Bathroom light. Walk out of the Bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating breakfast and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Kitchen. Turn on the Kitchen light. Open the Refrigerator door. Take out the milk carton and the bread. Close the Refrigerator door. Put the bread into the Toaster. Press the Toaster lever down. Open the cupboard. Take out a plate and a cup. Place the plate and the cup on the counter. Take the toasted bread out of the Toaster. Put the bread on the plate. Pour milk from the carton into the cup. Sit down on the chair at the table. Pick up the bread. Eat the bread. Pick up the cup. Drink the milk. Put the cup down on the table. Stand up. Carry the plate and the cup to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the plate and the cup. Turn off the tap. Put the plate and the cup on the drying rack. Open the Refrigerator door. Put the milk carton back. Close the Refrigerator door. Wipe the counter with a cloth. Pick up the work bag. Pick up the keys from the counter. Pick up the Phone. Walk to the door. Open the door. Step out. Close the door.

Walk from the house to the bus stop. Hold the Phone in the right hand. Press the Phone screen. Look at the Phone screen. Put the Phone into the pocket. Stand at the bus stop. Step onto the bus. Take out the card. Tap the card on the reader. Put the card back into the pocket. Walk along the aisle. Sit down on a seat. Put the bag on the lap. Take out the Phone. Press the Phone screen. Put the Phone back into the pocket. Stand up when the bus stops. Walk to the door. Step off the bus. Walk along the street to the workplace. Push the entrance door open. Walk into the building. Press the elevator button. Step into the elevator. Press the floor button. Step out of the elevator. Walk to the ward desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Put on the work uniform. Pick up the stethoscope. Hang the stethoscope around the neck. Pick up the clipboard. Walk to the patient room. Open the door. Say 'Good morning' to the patient. Pick up the patient chart. Place the hand on the patient wrist to take the pulse. Write the reading on the clipboard. Adjust the IV drip rate with the hand. Press the call button. Walk to the nurse station. Sit down on the chair. Open the Computer. Press the power button. Type patient notes on the keyboard. Pick up the Phone when it rings. Say 'Hello, this is the ward'. Put the Phone down. Stand up. Walk to the medicine cabinet. Open the cabinet door. Take out the medicine box. Close the cabinet door. Carry the medicine box to the patient room. Hand the medicine box to the patient. Wrap the blood pressure cuff around the arm. Press the start button on the monitor. Write the blood pressure reading on the clipboard. Walk back to the nurse station. Sit down on the chair. Type on the keyboard. Talk with a colleague about the shift handover. Stand up. Take off the work uniform.

Walk out of the workplace building. Walk along the street to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take out the Phone. Press the Phone screen. Put the Phone into the pocket. Step onto the bus. Take out the card. Tap the card on the reader. Put the card back into the pocket. Walk along the aisle. Sit down on a seat. Put the bag on the lap. Look out of the window. Stand up when the bus stops. Walk to the door. Step off the bus. Walk along the street. Turn the corner. Walk up to the house door. Take out the keys. Insert the key into the lock. Turn the key. Push the door open. Step inside. Close the door. Take off the shoes. Hang the coat on the hook. Walk into the house.

Walk into the Kitchen. Turn on the Kitchen light. Open the Refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables and the meat. Close the Refrigerator door. Put the vegetables on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables. Pick up the meat. Put the meat into the pan. Turn on the InductionCooker. Press the switch on the RangeHood. Stir the food with the spatula. Add salt. Turn off the InductionCooker. Open the cupboard. Take out a plate. Put the food onto the plate. Carry the plate to the table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the chopsticks. Eat the food. Pick up the cup. Drink water. Put the chopsticks down. Stand up. Carry the plate to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the plate. Turn off the tap. Put the plate on the drying rack.

Walk from the Kitchen to the Living Room. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the remote control. Press the power button. Point the remote control at the TV. Press the channel button. Put the remote control on the sofa arm. Lean back on the sofa. Cross the legs. Pick up the Phone. Press the Phone screen. Put the Phone on the sofa. Pick up the remote control. Press the volume button. Put the remote control down. Stand up. Walk to the table. Pick up the bottle of water. Open the cap. Drink water. Close the cap. Put the bottle on the table. Sit down on the sofa again. Pick up the remote control. Press the power button. Stand up.

Walk from the Living Room to the Bathroom. Turn on the Bathroom light. Press the WaterHeater switch on. Turn on the shower tap. Adjust the water temperature with the hand. Take off the clothes. Step into the shower area. Stand under the water. Wet the hair. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Pour shampoo into the hand. Rub the hair with both hands. Rinse the hair under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap on the arms, chest and legs. Rinse the body. Turn off the shower tap. Step out of the shower area. Pick up the towel. Wipe the hair. Wipe the body. Hang the towel on the hook. Put on the bathrobe. Turn off the Bathroom light. Walk out of the Bathroom.

Walk from the Bathroom to the Living Room. Sit down on the chair at the desk. Open the Computer. Press the power button. Move the mouse on the desk. Type on the keyboard. Pick up the Phone. Press the Phone screen. Put the Phone down on the desk. Continue typing on the keyboard. Reach for the cup. Drink water. Put the cup down on the desk. Stand up. Walk to the sofa. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the remote control. Press the power button of the TV. Point the remote control at the TV. Press the channel button. Put the remote control on the sofa arm. Lean back on the sofa. Watch the TV. Pick up the Phone. Press the Phone screen. Put the Phone on the sofa. Pick up the remote control. Press the power button. Put the remote control down. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Living Room to Bedroom 1. Turn on the Bedroom 1 light. Walk to the desk. Put the Phone on the desk. Press the Phone screen. Put the Phone down. Open the wardrobe door. Take out the pajamas. Close the wardrobe door. Take off the bathrobe. Put on the pajamas. Walk to the bed. Pull the blanket down. Sit down on the edge of the bed. Pick up the Phone. Press the Phone screen. Put the Phone on the bedside table. Stand up. Walk to the door. Press the light switch. Turn off the light. Walk back to the bed. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Turn onto the right side. Adjust the pillow with the hand. Close the eyes.

Lie on the bed in Bedroom 1. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Close the eyes. Turn onto the left side. Adjust the pillow with the hand. Stay still. Turn onto the back. Pull the blanket up. Breathe steadily. Turn onto the right side. Extend the right arm. Withdraw the right arm. Remain motionless. Pull the blanket down slightly. Turn the head to the other side. Stay lying down.
